*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: src/components/PromptCard.tsx
@@
-    <article className={`tile ${prompt.isFavorite ? 'saved' : ''}`} style={{ '--ar': prompt.aspect } as React.CSSProperties} data-testid="prompt-card">
+    <article className={`tile ${prompt.isFavorite ? 'saved' : ''}`} style={{ '--ar': prompt.aspect } as React.CSSProperties} data-testid="prompt-card" onClick={() => onPreview(prompt)}>
@@
-      <button className="media" onClick={() => onPreview(prompt)} aria-label={`Open ${prompt.title}`}>
+      <button className="media" aria-label={`Open ${prompt.title}`} tabIndex={-1}>
@@
-          <button className={`bm ${prompt.isFavorite ? 'on' : ''}`} onClick={() => onFavorite(prompt)} aria-label={prompt.isFavorite ? 'Remove favorite' : 'Save favorite'}><Icon name="heart" /></button>
+          <button className={`bm ${prompt.isFavorite ? 'on' : ''}`} onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onFavorite(prompt) }} aria-label={prompt.isFavorite ? 'Remove favorite' : 'Save favorite'}><Icon name="heart" /></button>
@@
-            <button className="add" onClick={() => onCart(prompt)}>{prompt.price === 0 ? 'Get' : 'Add'} <Icon name="arrow" /></button>
+            <button className="add" onClick={(event) => { event.stopPropagation(); onCart(prompt) }}>{prompt.price === 0 ? 'Get' : 'Add'} <Icon name="arrow" /></button>
*** End Patch
